theme.description: Premium luxury fashion and pageant app. Uses deep midnight blacks with gold metallic accents, high-contrast imagery, and large cinematic hero banners inspired by Vogue and Netflix UI.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 for cards to create breathing room.
layout.cards: Netflix-style minimal cards. No generic white drop shadows. Use subtle 1px border border-white/10 and light top highlight.
layout.hero: Vogue/Netflix style large hero banners covering 70-80vh on mobile. Uses gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/40 to-transparent).

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#B5952F] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 backdrop-blur-md

inputs.default: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] transition-all

bottomNav.container: absolute bottom-0 w-full backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/80 border-t border-white/10 pb-safe pt-2

statusTracker.container: flex flex-col gap-4 relative before:absolute before:left-3 before:top-2 before:bottom-2 before:w-[2px] before:bg-white/10
statusTracker.iconActive: w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37] shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(212,175,55,0.5)] flex items-center justify-center
statusTracker.iconInactive: w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use 'data-testid' attributes for all interactive components and forms (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use Tailwind classes for styling within Expo NativeWind. Focus strictly on .js files (no .tsx).
Implement smooth transitions using React Native Reanimated or standard Animated API for mobile to mimic Netflix-like browsing.
Do not use generic purple or teal gradients. Stick exclusively to the Deep Black (#050505) and Gold (#D4AF37) palette.
Use high-contrast luxury UI principles: dark background, subtle 1px white/10% borders for cards, and heavy glassmorphism overlays.
Hero sections must take up significant screen real estate (Netflix style) with strong gradient overlays fading into the black background to make text legible.
Ensure the bottom navigation reflects a premium feel (glass blur, gold active indicators).
For the Application Status Tracker timeline: Utilize the specified statusTracker components with a progress stepper featuring gold filled states for completed actions.
Ensure text hierarchy utilizes the serif font for major headings (Vogue style) and clean sans-serif for body readability.
